notes: Counts equal the survey: SP 13 units + 3 leaders (SP/LN 6, LT 2, GR 2, ML 1, FA 2), FR 15 + 3 (LN 9, LT 2, ML 2, FA 2). No page/map differences.

Terrain: 24 hills, 11 forests, 11 river hexes (survey: 24, 11, 6 river + 5 bend). Hills under blocks are read from the ray rings (scan.py 0.13-0.17 on 3,0 3,10 4,0 3,9 etc.); 2,5 (under a leader stack) scans at 0.11, just under the threshold, but its ray ring and the dotted outline show it is a hill and the hill total then equals the survey's 24. Forest under blocks: 3,8 and 4,6 (SP/LT) read from the tree art around the block.

Bidassoa River (fordable by scenario rule, so plain river hexes with no crossing; no bridges): 7,0 7,1 7,2 6,3 6,4 6,5 7,5 7,6 7,7 7,8 8,9, entering from the left edge at 7,0 and leaving through the bottom at 8,9. One piece. FR blocks stand on the river hexes 7,1 7,2 7,6 and 7,7.

Objectives: the three black-and-white dotted outlines are the hill groups. Left 6 hexes: 1,1 2,1 2,2 3,0 3,2 4,0; centre 7 hexes: 1,6 1,7 2,4 2,5 2,6 2,8 3,6; right 6 hexes: 1,10 2,11 3,9 3,10 3,11 4,12 (the counts match the survey). The plain hexes 3,1 (left) and 2,7 (centre) lie in notches of the outlines: the dotted line runs along their sides, so they are not in a group. The Spanish start with all three group banners (three Spanish flags on the banner track).

Leaders (names read from the vertical labels at 4-6x): Del Barco (lone horse block, 1,0), Losada (2,5, on SP/LN), Porlier (3,9, on SP/LN; 'Porlier' is the likely reading of a small label that looks like 'Porker'), Reille (7,7, on FR/LN), Lamartiniere (8,11, on FR/LN), Villatte (lone horse block, 8,3).
The red dashed lines at columns 3/4 and 8/9 are section lines, not terrain. FR moves first (survey 117); the map carries no first-player marker.
